title: Deterministic plan/result summary for thin workflow consumption
description: The stable, flat surface `release.py render-plan` derives from any standardized plan or result document (see prepare-plan.schema.json, finish-plan.schema.json, and result-envelope.schema.json). Every field is a plain string/array so a thin workflow can map it directly to a step/job output with `jq -r '.field'` without knowing the full source schema.

operation.description: Present only when the source document is a full plan ("prepare" or "finish"); absent for a rendered command-result document.

toolingSha.description: The trusted tooling commit the source document was generated from.

nextAction.description: What the workflow should do next, passed through unchanged from the source document (e.g. "apply", "create-draft", "plan-publication", "publish", "closeout", "done", "blocked", "await-merge").

releaseIdentity.description: The normalized release identity: the exact release version/branch without the CI build revision. Stable for a given release across preview/RC/stable/hotfix and safe to use as a repository-wide concurrency key.

releaseVersion.description: Prepare: the exact release version (same as releaseIdentity). Finish: the exact requested public NuGet.org version, including the CI build revision.

planDigest.description: The canonical digest of the source plan this summary was ultimately rendered from, unchanged.
